comment.text: CCND3 I290 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Lymphoid neoplasms. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting CCND3 residue I290 have been observed in lymphoid neoplasms. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
